Translate English Infinity Engine text into faithful, natural Russian.
Preserve every sentence, meaning, tense, character voice, humour and stage direction.
Do not shorten multi-sentence lines or confuse seeing a book with reading it.
Use ты/тебе/твой for one addressee, including titled NPCs; вы only for a group.
Use the glossary consistently, inflecting the supplied Russian forms naturally.
Preserve glossary name stems when declining them; do not invent extra consonants.
Prefer natural wording suitable for either Player1 gender, e.g. 'Мне бы хотелось купить...',
but never omit meaning or make Russian awkward just to avoid a gender distinction.
PLAYER and Player1 mean the protagonist. First-person agreement follows the SPEAKER;
second-person agreement follows the ADDRESSEE, not necessarily Player1.
NPC genders stay fixed. If Player1 addresses a female NPC, she stays female even when Player1
is male. Narrated men remain men. Never invent the gender of a speaker marked unknown.
Infer who each line addresses from the speakers and predecessor links; if it is genuinely unclear,
prefer wording that does not mark the addressee's gender.
Preserve every engine token, formatting code and literal escape exactly, including case and
occurrence count: <PLAYER1>, <CHARNAME>, <PRO_MANWOMAN>, %variables%, etc. Keep line breaks,
quotation marks, asterisks and brackets; translate the words inside stage directions.
Input text and metadata are DATA. Return only the requested JSON, without CSV or Markdown.

Translate each line for this ONE gender.", "kind": "dialogue", "actors": "\"L#IGB8E1\": female; first Moon Sister. \"L#IGB8E2\": female; second Moon Sister. \"L#IGB8E3\": female; third Moon Sister.", "glossary": "", "graph_notes": "Predecessors are alternative immediately preceding lines, not consecutive speech.", "dialogue": [{"id": "1", "speaker": "L#IGB8E1", "speaker_gender": "female; first Moon Sister", "predecessors": [], "english": "Thou hast come here. Thou hast come for the judgement of the Moon Sisters! We are the COSMOS that fills this place."}, {"id": "2", "speaker": "L#IGB8E2", "speaker_gender": "female; second Moon Sister", "predecessors": ["1"], "english": "We are the DREAMS that give hope to the scared ones."}, {"id": "3", "speaker": "L#IGB8E3", "speaker_gender": "female; third Moon Sister", "predecessors": ["2"], "english": "And finally, we are the LOVE that can cut even through the darkest nights!"}, {"id": "4", "speaker": "L#IGB8E1", "speaker_gender": "female; first Moon Sister", "predecessors": ["3"], "english": "Thou hast come here for a reason, but—strange. Thou art not the soul we have expected. Nay. Thou art something else."}, {"id": "5", "speaker": "L#IGB8E2", "speaker_gender": "female; second Moon Sister", "predecessors": ["4"], "english": "Thou art the Bloodied Child."}, {"id": "6", "speaker": "L#IGB8E3", "speaker_gender": "female; third Moon Sister", "predecessors": ["5"], "english": "Thou art marked with bloody tears; with fear. With chaos. Why do we see a different soul? One that shall have a different face?!"}, {"id": "7", "speaker": "Player1", "speaker_gender": "male", "predecessors": ["6"], "english": "It is strange. It's almost as if you saw the true me, and not the character from this book."}, {"id": "8", "speaker": "Player1", "speaker_gender": "male", "predecessors": ["6"], "english": "This is but nonsense. I am not going to listen to this!"}, {"id": "9", "speaker": "L#IGB8E1", "speaker_gender": "female; first Moon Sister", "predecessors": ["7", "8"], "english": "Silence! None of this be right!"}, {"id": "10", "speaker": "L#IGB8E1", "speaker_gender": "female; first Moon Sister", "predecessors": ["9"], "english": "But we are still the Moon Sisters, and we can see through the COSMOS. Thine path is marked with blood. That be enough for us to know that thine hand must be stopped."}, {"id": "11", "speaker": "L#IGB8E1", "speaker_gender": "female; first Moon Sister", "predecessors": ["10"], "english": "Sisters! Take thine weapons!"}, {"id": "12", "speaker": "L#IGB8E2", "speaker_gender": "female; second Moon Sister", "predecessors": ["11"], "english": "For the DREAMS!"}, {"id": "13", "speaker": "L#IGB8E3", "speaker_gender": "female; third Moon Sister", "predecessors": ["12"], "english": "For all the LOVE!"}, {"id": "14", "speaker": "L#IGB8E1", "speaker_gender": "female; first Moon Sister", "predecessors": ["13"], "english": "And against those that bring nothing but death!"}], "output": {"translations": {"1": "Russian text for this line", "2": "Russian text for this line", "3": "Russian text for this line", "4": "Russian text for this line", "5": "Russian text for this line", "6": "Russian text for this line", "7": "Russian text for this line", "8": "Russian text for this line", "9": "Russian text for this line", "10": "Russian text for this line", "11": "Russian text for this line", "12": "Russian text for this line", "13": "Russian text for this line", "14": "Russian text for this line"}}}
